terms.latin: Quod fors feret, ferēmus aequō animō.
terms.gloss: come what may, we’ll take it calmly
terms.comment: Fors, chance, what luck brings: literally “what chance brings, we shall bear with a level mind”. Cicero has the like ut fors tulerit, as luck will have it (Att., Lewis & Short s.v. fors).

phrases.latin: Ūnum hoc sciō: quod fors feret, ferēmus aequō animō.
phrases.english: I know this one thing: whatever luck brings, we’ll bear it calmly.
